title: Resume failed member QA with its retained owner
when: An owner receives its failed verdict, a driver discovers failed member QA, or a parked owner resumes after a correction notice on a surface without automatic wake.
need: Classify product, setup, case or unclear cause. Fix current-item failures here by default; justify separately owned corrections and record the directional closure edge with the exact completion or named-environment milestone. Keep the claim, lane and checkpoint while an explicit blocker holds. Steering staffs and delivers corrections and arranges supported manual resume. Reread all blockers and target evidence; same-run admission and a cleared dependency cannot authorize stale frozen-candidate QA. An inherited fail recorded before this run retries with the item-scoped plan run, not a deployment-run id. A failure created after this run follows the ordinary rework handoff. Run the retry command on the qualifying deployed correction. Preserve failed and skipped history; no notice or replacement waives remaining cases.
surface: Failed-member notice to qa plan run help; authoritative failed-item QA recipe; steering rework and wait guidance
gap: Source and test observations do not prove real notice delivery or manual resumption. See failed-item-qa-live-proof.
review: Live proof remains pending; no production failure is manufactured for guidance verification.
recipes: yoke qa plan run --item PREFIX-N --stage item-qa --project PROJECT
